'''Crivor''' was an inmate at [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s [[Q'Maere Research Facility|penal facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Q'Maere]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], he was rescued by the crew of the ''[[FarStar]]'', and volunteered for duty onboard the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. During his time serving on the corvette, he refused to take any orders that did not originate from [[Lowen Chase]], the leader of the former prisoners and the man responsible for engineering the jailbreak that helped the crew of the ''FarStar'' to free him.
